column2: DEFER severity=LOW — src/lib/admin/parcel-lookup.ts "const comparableBuilds = Array.isArray(row.comparable_builds) ? (row.comparable_builds as ComparableBuild[]) : null;" — the one Tier 2 jsonb field that skips validation: an element-shaped drift is handed to the client typed as ComparableBuild[] while the two neighbouring jsonb fields degrade through safeParse — add a ComparableBuildSchema.safeParse here and push a warning plus logWarn on failure, as the cost menu and nearby summary do.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/lib/admin/parcel-lookup.ts "const num = (v: unknown): number | null => (v == null ? null : Number(v));" — a non-numeric string returns NaN, which contradicts the declared number | null and the areas branch three lines below ("never coerce to NaN"), so compStats and the cost scalars can carry NaN to the admin UI — return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts "switches: (typeof r.switches === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r.switches) : r.switches ?? null) as NonNullable<StoredRow['switches']> | null," — JSON.parse can throw a bare SyntaxError with no parcel or field context and this module has no catch or log, and the cast asserts an array shape that project.ts then silently drops — parse under try/catch that logs and yields null, or assert Array.isArray.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/lib/report-projection/project.ts "const HIDDEN_STATES: string[] = (presentation as unknown as { states: { hidden: string[] } }).states.hidden;" — a table drift leaves HIDDEN_STATES undefined and the first projection throws a TypeError on .includes instead of a named load-time refusal, unlike pinned-settings.ts which throws by name — check Array.isArray at load and throw naming report-presentation.json (same for STATUS_TEXT below it).

DEFER severity=NIT — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs "(72 SQL-bearing files: 41 static, 29 interpolated, 2 not_postgres)" — the counted header still says 72 files and 29 interpolated while the sentence it introduces adds "the 30th" — recount the header so the measured set and its prose agree.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/lib/report-projection/format.ts "export type PageRule = (typeof PAGE_RULES)[number];" — never referenced: formatPageRule takes a bare "rule: string", so the closed rule union is declared but unused — either type the parameter against the union or drop the export.

DEFER severity=MED — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "const f = formatPageRule(rule, n) as { value: string; unit?: string };" — the cast drops the nullable return, so a formatter refusal surfaces as "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'value')" and the failure names no rule, while the same file asserts the same call returns null for bad input ("expect(formatPageRule('pct0', 3)).toBeNull();") — replace the cast with a null check that throws `formatter refused ${rule} ${n}` — a real refusal is currently reported as a type error, not a test failure.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "return (unit ? f.unit : f.value) as string;" — `unit?: string` is asserted to `string`, so an `area_sqft` result without a unit would print "undefined sq ft" from the template literal that consumes it ("expect(`${fmt('area_sqft', m)} sq ft`).toBe(...)"), and no call site in the file passes the third argument so the `unit` branch is dead — drop the parameter and the branch, or assert `typeof f.unit === 'string'` before returning it.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "const dirs = JSON.parse(((/const DIRS = (\[[^\]]*\])/.exec(lock) as RegExpExecArray)[1] as string).replace(/'/g, '\"')) as string[];" — `RegExpExecArray` is asserted non-null on a nullable `exec` result, so a renamed `DIRS` line in report-no-maths.logic.test.ts crashes the test with "Cannot read properties of null (reading '1')" — bind the match first and `expect(m).not.toBeNull()` before indexing.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "const o3Pairs = new Set(pageBindings().flatMap((b) => (b.section === 'o3' && b.source.kind === 'catalogue' ? [b.source.field_id] : []))).size;" — this counts o3 field ids without the `building_type !== null` filter that `unwritten` applies ("if (b.building_type === null || b.source.kind !== 'catalogue') continue;") and it counts distinct field ids while the findings are keyed per pair, so a null-typed or second-typed o3 binding makes "expect(findings).toHaveLength(o3Pairs)" fail for the wrong reason — count the same `${section} ${field_id} ${building_type}` triples `unwritten` uses.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "interface DigitText { key: string; count: number; kind: 'legal' | 'input_hint' | 'exception'; why: string }" — the 'exception' member can never be used because the same describe asserts it empty ("expect(DIGIT_TEXTS.filter((e) => e.kind === 'exception')).toEqual([]);"), a dead union member introduced by this diff — drop 'exception' from the union.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/tests/report-projection-settings.logic.test.ts "import { pinnedSetting } from '@/lib/report-projection/pinned-settings';" and "import { pinnedWindow } from '@/lib/report-projection/pinned-settings';" — two import statements from one module in the same file, which `import/no-duplicates` rejects — merge into one statement.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts "expect(fs.existsSync(`${PROJ}/format.ts`)).toBe(true);" — placed after "expect(fs.readFileSync(`${PROJ}/format.ts`, 'utf8')).not.toMatch(...)" on the same path, so it can never be the assertion that reports a missing file, the readFileSync throws first — move the existence check above the read.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/runtime-loader.logic.test.ts:48 "for (const d of D.config.logic_variables as Json[]) out[d.name] = lv[d.name].default;" — a descriptor variable absent from logic_variables.json throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'default')" inside beforeAll, failing the whole file without naming the variable — read `const v = lv[d.name]; if (!v) throw new Error(`${d.name} is missing from logic_variables.json`);` then `v.default`.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/golden25-harness.ts:64 "const e = expected.find((x) => x.parcel_id === lot.parcel_id) as Json;" — the `as Json` cast hides a possible undefined, so a lot with no expected line dies later at `String(e.case).split('_')[0]` with an unnamed TypeError — throw naming `lot.parcel_id` before using `e`.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/runtime-loader.logic.test.ts:129 "const row = house.get(field) as Json;" — a field with no emitted row yields undefined and `row.status` throws a TypeError instead of failing with the `${e.case}/${key}` message the call already carries — add `expect(row, `${e.case}/${key}`).toBeDefined()` before the cast.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/runtime-loader.logic.test.ts:134 "expect(row.status, `${e.case}/${key}`).toBe('not_evaluated');" — every non-number golden cell is asserted to be exactly not_evaluated, while test (c) in the same file lists not_modelled, not_permitted, unlimited, unregulated, not_applicable, not_buildable as legal statuses, so a legitimately not_permitted cell would fail with a misleading message — assert the cell's own status word instead of a hardcoded one.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/runtime-loader.logic.test.ts:152 "expect(text).toContain(\"CONSTRAINT parcel_maxbld_scenarios_value_iff_computed CHECK ((status = 'computed') = (value IS NOT NULL) OR (field_id = 'gain_reasons' AND status = 'computed' AND value IS NULL))\");" — pins migration 309's DDL text character for character, so a pure reformat of the migration reddens a test whose subject is emitted row values — match the constraint name with a tolerant regex and leave the semantics to the "every golden row passes both predicates" test.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/surfaces/report-honest-k2b.logic.test.ts:18 "const part = (section: string, role: string): Json => (PAGE.sections as Json[]).find((s) => s.id === section)!.parts.find((p: Json) => p.role === role);" — the non-null assertion on `find` means a renamed section fails as "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'parts')" inside a helper, not as an assertion naming the id — return `Json | undefined` and assert defined at the call site with `section`/`role` in the message.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/tests/steps/compute_maxbld_scenarios/golden25-harness.ts:17 "export const META = { layer2_table_version: 'g25', settings_sha: 'g25' };" — no file in the material references META, since the runtime test takes its stamp from the producer, so unless a consumer outside this chunk imports it, it is a dead export — delete it or use it where the g25 stamp is set; the other importers are cannot see.

DEFER severity=LOW — src-sql-ledger.mjs CLOSED_INTERPOLATED_SET header, line 76 "it may not grow (`grew:`)" — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs:78 "SQL-bearing files: 41 static, 29 interpolated, 2 not_postgres); LOAD.1 (task-266," — the amended measure line still totals 72 files with 29 interpolated while the same patch states a 30th interpolated file is added, so the recorded baseline and the array disagree; fix: restate the measure as 73 files, 41 static, 30 interpolated, 2 not_postgres, or label 29 as the pre-LOAD.1 count — comment only, bounded, nothing changes behaviour, recorded under RR-0385.

DEFER severity=NIT — prereg-MB-44-2.json $comment "generated files regenerated by their own scripts (src-sql-ledger, consumer-registry, the surface registry and census for the lookup descriptor data_story)" — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs:111 "'src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts', // LOAD.1 (task-266, dated note 2026-11-19): the batch statement text is built by the Layer 3 step's own core" — the ledger hunk is hand-written prose plus a hand-inserted array entry with an inline comment, so "regenerated by their own scripts" does not describe how this file changed; fix: either name the generator that emits this prose (cannot see it) or change prereg-2 to say the ledger set was edited and re-measured by hand — record only, the `grew:`/`stale:` guard (script not pasted, cannot see) is the real check.

DEFER severity=MED — §11.1 "a data claim carries its query run (host + `current_database()` printed" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-1.json:83 "no floor line falls; the floors file is unchanged and the floors check stays OK" — the floors result, the before and after totals at :12 and :23 and the "every row of the 172, 4d and cumulative sets: class and City figure" census at :84 are executable claims carried with no run at this round's base, only "totals and floors copied from prereg-MF-91-1.json (round 195)" (:2), and prereg-MB-44-2.json:83 repeats the same set — record the scorer and floors invocations with the printed host and current_database() and the base sha in each prereg, or cite the round-195 run lines by sha.

DEFER severity=MED — §11.1 "a SQL shape is parse-tested against a real DB before any reviewer approves it" — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs:111 "'src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts', // LOAD.1 (task-266, dated note 2026-11-19): the batch statement text is built by the Layer 3 step's own core (buildSourceSql: checked-literal settings and the one lot id read from the database as an integer; the binds are last_key and batch_size), passed as a variable" — the change admits a 30th interpolated SQL site to the closed set and the entry records no parse test, and the file it describes is outside the pasted material (cannot see) — record the parse-test invocation and its result in the ledger entry or point the entry at the lane record that holds them.

DEFER severity=MED — §11.8 MCINC-8 "Every MF, FE, MB, migration, prereg round, D and M number is claimed in `~/Buildo-scratch/ids` before it is used anywhere" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-2.json:2 "In-file round 198, claimed in the ID ledger (~/Buildo-scratch/ids/round-198)" — the round claim is satisfied only by the artifact's own $comment (round 197 likewise at prereg-MB-44-1.json:4), and the ledger is outside the repo (cannot see), so claim-before-use is asserted, not shown — cite the ledger owner file (path and contents or digest) or the ids/check.mjs output in the round record.

DEFER severity=LOW — §11.4 "cases, fixtures, red/green expectations, invocation mode" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-2.json:2 "tests: one new file customer-report-compute.logic.test.ts, customer-report-read.logic.test.ts re-pinned (T7 stale lot, T10 importers)" — the pre-registered test moves name files and two case tags only, with no cases, fixtures, red/green expectations or invocation mode, and PLAN.md is outside the pasted material (cannot see) — carry the failing-case list in the prereg or cite the PLAN.md section that holds it.

DEFER severity=NIT — §7.10 dated note 2026-11-06 (C2) "a rule is cited by its id and anchor first, with the line number as a hint dated by the commit sha" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-1.json:7 ""M-384"" — the rule that licenses the change is cited by id alone, no anchor and no dated line hint; C2 is written for operator recommendations and a prereg is a lane artifact, so this is a nit — add the anchor and a line-at-sha hint beside M-384.

DEFER severity=NIT — m.360 "accept moves only named lines" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-1.json "$comment": "Zero scorer moves (no file under scripts/analysis/bylaw, scripts/seeds/bylaw or docs/reference/bylaw changes)" — the parenthetical is contradicted by the file's own path, a new file under scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/, so a later reader can take it as "nothing in that tree changed" — scope the parenthetical to scorer inputs, seeds and goldens, and name the prereg file as the one permitted addition

DEFER severity=LOW — m.511 "CITE-2 cite by id and anchor" — prereg-MB-44-1.json:2 "no by-law reading changes and no literal or zone name enters code (M-61)" — the literal-free claim is anchored to M-61, which governs declared formula report fields and says nothing about literals or zone names, the pasted rule that names non-law literals is m.68 — re-anchor the claim to M-68 (and m.46 for the heuristic door) and leave M-61 to the formula statement it supports.

DEFER severity=LOW — m.513 "CITE-4 stage-6 prereg rules[] checklist" — prereg-MB-44-2.json:6 "\"rules\": [ \"M-384\" ]" — both preregs carry a one-rule checklist while the round's own comment rests on the read rule and the projection rules (M-61, the m.305 coa-* tool layout, the m.321 pre-registration it is performing), so the checklist does not record every rule the round is checked against — list each rule the round is checked against, not only M-384.

DEFER severity=LOW — m.320 "Each City figure is scored against the by-law in force on its decision date" — prereg-MB-44-1.json:84 "\"expected_unchanged\": \"every row of the 172, 4d and cumulative sets: class and City figure\"" — the prereg asserts every City figure is untouched without recording the in_force_basis those figures were scored against (the basis m.375 requires a scope note to name) — record the in_force_basis pin beside expected_unchanged in both files.

DEFER severity=LOW — m.116 "table_version = <adoption_id>:<sha256 of the LF bylaw-provisions.json>, the same sha oracle C records" — prereg-MB-44-1.json:3 "\"schema\": \"coa-round-prereg-v1\"," — neither prereg records any table_version, so round 197 and round 198 declare 407 MATCH and 459 cumulative MATCH against no pinned table and the zeros cannot later be shown to have been scored on the same bylaw-provisions.json — add the table_version pin to both preregs, the same value the round record carries.

BUG severity=HIGH — phase "One of the runner functions in table 1a that owns a step's reads, writes and transactions." — src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts:93 "const row = (await pool.query<Json>(plan.batch_sql, [lot.id - 1, 1])).rows[0];" — The compute step's own batch read of parcel_maxbld_scenarios is executed by a src/ module, so the step's reads have an executor outside the phase the clause assigns them to. — Put the statement behind one named step entry that the phase also calls, and have src/ call that entry.

DEFER severity=MED — seam "cross-step seams are producer → consumer edges (`inputs.reads.steps`); the ENRICHER write seam is `ctx.exec` / `ctx.joinUpdate`, where the runner, not compute, issues the DML." — src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts:87 "const plan = buildSourceSql(descriptor, { ...config, [POPULATION_SETTING]: [String(lot.id)] }, {});" — This compute-to-src hand-off is an edge no pasted vocabulary declares, there is no inputs.reads.steps entry and no ctx.exec, so nothing names who may run a core-built statement. — Declare the edge in the descriptor's declared reads, or route execution the ctx.exec way so one place owns it.

DEFER severity=MED — compute hook "A named function or value on the compute module that a phase calls or reads"; "the main function is called once after the phase." — src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts:33 "const UNITS_SQL = 'SELECT unit_key, unit_id FROM bylaw_resolution_units';" — The descriptor's declared role lookups are re-written by hand beside the core and the only guard is the test the comment names at :32, which is not in this chunk (cannot see), so the hook boundary is asserted and not shown. — Read the lookups through the step's own lookup reader instead of a second statement.

DEFER severity=LOW — Task "Tasks homed in this group: task-69, task-123, task-266, task-318, task-333, task-372." read with RR-0433 "tasks 381, 383, 390, 395 and 411 were folded as they stood" — src/lib/report-projection/format.ts:52 "export const TEXT_RULES = ['yes_no', 'confidence'] as const;" — The yes/no and confidence text rules are ordered by no homed or folded task and by no pasted ruling, the file's own K2 quote at :46 is the only authority. — Cite the pasted card or ruling that orders the text rules, or split them out of this change.

DEFER severity=LOW — RR-0433 "tasks 381, 383, 390, 395 and 411 were folded as they stood" — scripts/seeds/logic_variables.json:9790 "Re-pinned from 27.5 to 33.2 on 2026-11-20 (migration 334)" — The pre-commit budget re-pin is named by no pasted card (the pasted group names task-395 and task-406 for this file) and its cited authority, MORNING-DECISIONS.md:1504 and :1526, is not pasted, so the owning card cannot be seen. — Name the owning card in the reviewed set, or move the re-pin out of this change.

DEFER severity=NIT — lock / lock-db / check / hook "a lock is a test under `src/tests/` run by `npm test` that names the rule id (or a declared alias) and asserts it" — src/lib/report-projection/read-stored.ts:13 "lock L1 in src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts stays true" — The import fence rests on a label L1 that names no rule id in the pasted list, and the test is not in this chunk (cannot see), so the claim is unauditable here. — Name the asserted rule id in the comment, or drop the L1 label.
BUG severity=HIGH — none

DEFER severity=MED — task-372 criteria pointer "FIX.PROJ-Report-projection-freshness-compares-the-whole-stamp-the-sq-ft-factor-and-the-lot-size-window-are-settings-a-property-test-on-rounding-D1-D2-D9-D6" — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts:544 "stamp: { ...STAMP, table_version: 'newer' }" — the only stamp-drift lock moves table_version (moved equals layer2, catalogue at :546); no test varies evaluator_version although the stamp read and STAMP both carry it, so "compares the whole stamp" has no lock for that component — add one case whose stamp differs only in evaluator_version and assert verdict out_of_date naming the component.

DEFER severity=LOW — Glossary "lock / lock-db / check / hook" "A lock is a test under `src/tests/` run by `npm test` that names the rule id (or a declared alias) and asserts it" — src/tests/property/report-sqft-rounding.property.test.ts:1 "docs/specs/00_engineering_standards.md §12.12" — the rounding lock names a spec section, not a rule id, so under the pasted definition it cannot be cited as a lock by id — cite the rule id (or declared alias) it locks in the header and the describe title.

DEFER severity=LOW — Glossary "lock / lock-db / check / hook" "A lock is a test under `src/tests/` run by `npm test` that names the rule id (or a declared alias) and asserts it" — src/tests/search-parser-guard.logic.test.ts:1 "docs/specs/02-web-admin/89_parcel_cost_model_tool.md §3 (line 33 dated note 2026-11-19, ONE-12 a)" — the search lock names a section and a decision id; A.4 and A.5 are card elements, not rule ids, so no lock id in the pasted vocabulary is cited — name the rule id the A.4 and A.5 behaviours lock.

DEFER severity=LOW — Glossary "Gate A … K, V" "Gate E is compute purity, Gate F the score floor." — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts:7 "//   F   the FE-05 formatter: the v21 golden strings, the pinned grouping, parity with the mobile helpers, honest refusals, its directory and no imports;" — the formatter lock is labelled F, which in the pasted vocabulary is Gate F the score floor, so the label reads as a spec gate it is not — rename the label (for example FMT) so no lock id collides with a pasted gate letter.

DEFER severity=NIT — Glossary "SCORECARD-G0 … SCORECARD-G9" — src/tests/admin-report-preview-live.logic.test.ts:8 "//   G25 the golden-25 key equals the producer's payload wherever the key states a Layer 3 value the page binds (rows from the step's own compute);" — the scorecard range is closed at G9, so a label G25 reads as a scorecard gate outside the closed set — rename to a card-local id such as KEY25.

DEFER severity=MED — doc-2 A.5 "| A.5 | A Search page · Unit number typed after the address | details | NOT-BUILT | 1.4 | NOT BUILT |" — src/lib/admin/parcel-lookup.ts:152 "The unit is not used to narrow the match (parcels are lots, not units; the ruled "add a unit number" text stays)." — doc-2 names 1.4 as the deliverer of A.5 and this change is 1.4, yet a typed unit is deleted before the parse, so the many-lots notice "Add a unit number or pick a nearby address" still fires for a user who just added one — fix: record in the lane that A.5 stays NOT-BUILT after 1.4 and that B.5's text is served unchanged, or return the unit-bearing outcome the element rules.

DEFER severity=MED — doc-2 G.6 "| G.6 | G Hand-off to the report · Report meter: a hit counts one report; report limit page when exhausted | main | AVAILABLE | LS.12 | BUILT |" — src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts:19 "Server only: no meter, no entitlement, no usage, no user id, no write." — the new hit path returns a servable page with no meter and no entitlement read, so "a hit counts one report" now rests entirely on src/app/api/parcels/lookup/route.ts, which is not in the pasted material (cannot see) — fix: land or cite the route's single meter around both the stored read and the compute entry in this review set.

DEFER severity=MED — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs:77 "it may not grow (`grew:`)" — scripts/analysis/src-sql-ledger.mjs:111 "'src/lib/parcels/report-compute.ts', // LOAD.1 (task-266, dated note 2026-11-19)" — the file states its closed interpolated set may not grow and the diff grows it from 29 to 30, so the ledger's own invariant and the change cannot both hold — fix: show the `grew:` acknowledgement the ledger mechanism expects, or keep the statement static so no new member is needed.

DEFER severity=LOW — doc-2 G.1 "| G.1 | G Hand-off to the report · Unique match goes straight to the report (no extra page) | main | AVAILABLE | | BUILT |" — src/lib/admin/parcel-lookup.ts:213 "return { match: null, candidates: rows.map((r) => ({ parcelId: r.parcel_id, address: r.address })), resolution: 'text_candidates', lotMap: null };" — a ONE-row hit whose printed direction differs from the typed one is turned into the candidate list, which is the extra page G.1 says a unique match never gets — fix: keep the single row as a unique match and surface the direction mismatch as a note, or cite the pasted ruling that authorises the downgrade.

DEFER severity=LOW — doc-2 E.5 "| E.5 | E Web search pages · W6 web report route /parcel-tool/{lot} | main | NOT-BUILT | LS.12 1.3 MB-44 | BUILT-NO-DATA |" — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-1.json:2 "MAXBLD_WEB_LIVE stays pinned false, so every customer still gets the miss; the problem Customer report returns nothing stays open." — doc-2 lists MB-44 as the deliverer of E.5 and G.5 and this change is the MB-44 landing, so both elements stay NOT-BUILT and the deliverer column is now unmet — fix: re-point E.5 and G.5 to the remaining MB-44 part, the pinned-false module being named by task-123's own title.

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/seeds/logic_variables.json:9782 "a change is a reviewed seed + migration commit" — scripts/seeds/logic_variables.json:9780 "Re-pinned from 27.5 to 33.2 on 2026-11-20 (migration 334)" — the row's own rule requires the seed change to arrive with its migration and the pasted material carries no migration file (cannot see), so half of the ruled pair is unverified — fix: include migration 334 in the review set or note why the DB mirror is out of the chunk.

DEFER severity=NIT — Implementation Notes "Left out of every group: generated files ... documents, lane and review records, backlog cards." — scripts/analysis/bylaw-validation/coa-expected/prereg-MB-44-1.json:2 "\"$comment\": \"Pre-registration, task MB-44 ... round 197, claimed in the ID ledger\"" — the two prereg files in this material are round records of exactly the kind the notes exclude, and their claim "Zero scorer moves (no file under scripts/analysis/bylaw ...)" is contradicted by their own path — fix: move the preregs out of the reviewed set and let the bylaw lane review them.

BUG severity=HIGH — task-372 "task-372 - FIX.PROJ-Report-projection-freshness-compares-the-whole-stamp-the-sq-ft-factor-and-the-lot-size-window-are-settings-a-property-test-on-rounding-D1-D2-D9-D6.md" — src/lib/report-projection/project.ts:182 "if (rows.some((r) => r.layer2_table_version !== stamp.table_version)) moved.push('layer2');" — the stamp is three fields ("export interface LotStamp { lot_gate: string | null; table_version: string | null; evaluator_version: string | null }", project.ts:48) and freshness compares one of them, so an evaluator-version move with the same table_version still reads 'current' while lineage.layer2_evaluator_version prints the newer evaluator — compare the rows' evaluator stamp against stamp.evaluator_version (store it per row, or compare the stamp pair) and push it into moved/lost.
